description: List the people (members) and roles (tafkidim) of a project. Use this to resolve a task assignee - a person or a role - to its ID before calling createTaskTool. For a task with no specific person, pick the roles that fit it here and pass their IDs as tafkidims. Docs: https://1lev1.com/mcp#getProjectMembersTool

query.description: Optional text to filter people or roles by name

name: getProjectMembersTool
